Class ProofAttemptService

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.service.ProofAttemptService
@Service public class ProofAttemptService extends Object
Counts wrong proofs per user: wrong or malformed second-factor codes at sign-in, and wrong passwords or codes given to an endpoint that manages sign-in methods. Five wrong proofs of one user within 15 minutes refuse every further proof of that user until 15 minutes after the fifth; a correct proof clears the count.

The lock is per user and leaves the client address alone, so the holder of a stolen password cannot lock other users out of their address, and the holder of a session cannot search the password at a management endpoint without being stopped. A missing code is a question, and a secret that cannot be decrypted is an operating fault; neither is counted. The counters live in the memory of the one JVM serving the database, bounded in number: the least recently touched entry gives way when the capacity is reached.
